              About

              A social media and technology studio, built in Faridabad.

              We connect creativity, technology, and strategic thinking to help businesses build stronger digital experiences.

              Get a proposalSee our work

              Mission

              Help ambitious businesses look and work like the best in their field.

              Neural Automation is a multidisciplinary studio: social media marketing and content production sit alongside websites, apps, AI agents and automation. Most projects combine two or three of these — which is exactly why they are built under one roof.

              Every engagement runs through one system: understand the business, plan the content, produce the creative that makes it visible, engineer the technology behind it, and remove the manual work along the way.

              Philosophy

              What we believe about the work.

              1. Strategy before content

                Every post, film or page has a job. We decide what it is before anything is produced.

              2. Craft is the differentiator

                Typography, pacing, light and restraint are what make a brand look expensive. We sweat them.

              3. Measure, then improve

                Weekly reviews and honest reporting. We change what isn't working instead of defending it.

              4. Technology that earns its place

                AI and automation where they remove real work or raise quality — never as decoration.

              Privacy

              Privacy notice

              Plain language: what this website collects when you contact us, and what happens to it.

              What we collect

              Only what you type into our forms: your name, company, business email, phone or WhatsApp number, country, industry, the services and platforms you are interested in, budget range, preferred dates and any notes you add. The Neural Growth Lab builds its example brief entirely in your browser.

              How your enquiry reaches us

              When you choose “Send on WhatsApp” or “Send by email”, your brief opens in your own WhatsApp or email app. It is only sent when you press send there, and it is then handled under WhatsApp's or your email provider's terms.

              How we use it

              Only to reply to your enquiry, prepare a proposal or arrange a call. We do not sell your details or add you to marketing lists without asking.

              Cookies and tracking

              No advertising or analytics cookies. Your browser may keep a small session flag so the opening animation plays only once per visit.

              Your choices

              To ask what we hold about you, correct it or have it deleted, email neural.automation.2009@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp at +91 70421 45705.

              From your brief to a confirmed quotation.

                You share objectives, requirements, features and scope.

              2. Package or service

              3. Scope & customisation

                Scope, features, revisions and deliverables are reviewed.
